subject.title: feat: AI safety event taxonomy — UI dashboard and CLI command

question: Should OpenClaw core adopt this AI-safety taxonomy as a public Plugin SDK contract and retain its events for an operator-facing CLI and dashboard?
rationale: The choice fixes permanent schema names, privacy and retention policy, gateway authorization, public SDK compatibility, and core UI scope; those product and security boundaries cannot be selected mechanically from this patch.

options.title: Sequence a core design
options.body: Approve the capability in principle but require separate, ordered PRs for the canonical schema, privacy/storage layer, exporters, and UI/CLI surface.

options.title: Accept the combined surface
options.body: Approve the taxonomy and monolithic delivery after owners explicitly sign off on its API, privacy, retention, and authorization contracts.

options.title: Pause the core feature
options.body: Close or defer the stack until a narrower operator-safety requirement and maintainer sponsor establish the permanent core boundary.

recommendation.title: Sequence a core design
recommendation.body: Approve the capability in principle but require separate, ordered PRs for the canonical schema, privacy/storage layer, exporters, and UI/CLI surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice spans core product scope, public SDK compatibility, security policy, persistence, and Control UI placement.
